description: National Physical Planning Department - The Town and Country Planning Ordinance (Chapter 269) Declare that the Land called "Sankapitti Purana Vihara area as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land-related matters, specifically declaring the "Sankapitti Purana Vihara Area" as an urban development area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, coordinates, and survey information, which fits the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters including land use planning and development areas.
